text: In the movies, a billionaire in a cape crashes through your skylight to save the world. In real life, your villain downfall is way less dramatic.

First, the tax agency flags nearly two billion dollars of unexplained volcano construction with zero filings. Next, the electric utility sends a technician in a pickup truck to disconnect your unpaid power meter.

Before a single hero arrives, federal marshals, aviation regulators, and local building inspectors freeze your bank accounts, tow your getaway trucks, and slap a heavy padlock right on your secret front door.
Turns out the deadliest force on Earth is not a death laser. It is compound interest, missing paperwork, and an unimpressed tax auditor.
So here is the real question: if you had a secret villain budget, which problem would ruin you first, the tax audit, the electric bill, or your own henchmen? Drop your answer in the comments.
